questions.stem: Which of the following is a common method of remunerating salespeople?
questions.explanation: Commission based on sales is a common method of remuneration that incentivizes salespeople to increase their sales. The other options do not represent effective remuneration methods.

distractorRationale.a: A fixed salary does not motivate performance like commission does.
distractorRationale.c: No payment is not a viable remuneration strategy.
distractorRationale.d: Relying solely on bonuses is not common; a mix is preferred.
